name: archidraw
description: Architecture-as-code editor: Mermaid text and a visual canvas, kept in sync.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @archidraw/app && npm run build -w archidraw-mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @archidraw/core && npm run test -w archidraw-mcp && npm run test -w @archidraw/app
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/app && tsc -p packages/mcp
